en.summary: wuqūb is something entering, sinking into, or disappearing into a location. In uses concerning the sun, moon, and darkness, it can express setting, disappearing, arriving, or enveloping. Waqb also names a hollow or depression in which something rests.

fa.title: ریشه قرآنی و ق د

en.title: Qur’anic Root W S W S ( و س و س )
en.summary: in acoustic usage, waswasah is quiet, hidden sound; in relation to a person, it is speech or thought that passes within them or is suggested in a concealed way. Such prompting may come from the person’s own self or another agent. Whether it is wrong, deceptive, or satanic is determined by the agent, content, and context, rather than by the root alone.
